<?php

class ImageResource {
    private $handle;
    private $metadata;
    private $refCount;
    
    public function __construct($path) {
        $data = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($data === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Unable to read image file');
        }
        $handle = @imagecreatefromstring($data);
        if ($handle === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid or unsupported image data');
        }
        $this->handle = $handle;
        $this->metadata = ['path' => $path, 'created' => time()];
        $this->refCount = 1;
    }
    
    public function addRef() {
        $this->refCount++;
        return $this;
    }
    
    public function release() {
        $this->refCount--;
        if ($this->refCount <= 0) {
            if ($this->handle) {
                imagedestroy($this->handle);
                $this->handle = null;
            }
        }
    }
    
    public function getHandle() {
        return $this->handle;
    }
    
    public function isValid() {
        return $this->handle !== null;
    }
}

class PipelineStage {
    private $callback;
    private $resource;
    private $next;
    
    public function __construct(callable $callback) {
        $this->callback = $callback;
        $this->resource = null;
        $this->next = null;
    }
    
    public function setResource(ImageResource $res) {
        $this->resource = $res;
    }
    
    public function chain(PipelineStage $next) {
        $this->next = $next;
        return $next;
    }
    
    public function execute() {
        $result = ($this->callback)($this->resource);
        if ($this->next !== null) {
            $this->next->setResource($this->resource);
            return $this->next->execute();
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

class RoleBasedAccessControl {
    private $permissions;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->permissions = [
            'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'transform', 'delete'],
            'editor' => ['read', 'write', 'transform'],
            'viewer' => ['read']
        ];
    }
    
    public function hasPermission(string $role, string $action): bool {
        if (!isset($this->permissions[$role])) {
            return false;
        }
        return in_array($action, $this->permissions[$role], true);
    }
}

class ImageProcessingPipeline {
    private $rbac;
    private $stages;
    private $asyncCallbacks;
    private $resourcePool;
    
    public function __construct(RoleBasedAccessControl $rbac) {
        $this->rbac = $rbac;
        $this->stages = [];
        $this->asyncCallbacks = [];
        $this->resourcePool = [];
    }
    
    public function loadImage(string $path, string $role): ?ImageResource {
        if (!$this->rbac->hasPermission($role, 'read')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied');
        }
        $realPath = realpath($path);
        if ($realPath === false || strpos($realPath, '/var/uploads/') !== 0) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid path');
        }
        $resource = new ImageResource($realPath);
        $this->resourcePool[] = $resource;
        return $resource;
    }
    
    public function registerAsyncCallback(string $eventName, callable $callback, ImageResource $resource) {
        $resource->addRef();
        $this->asyncCallbacks[$eventName][] = [
            'fn' => $callback,
            'resource' => $resource
        ];
    }
    
    public function processWithTransform(ImageResource $resource, string $role, array $transforms) {
        if (!$this->rbac->hasPermission($role, 'transform')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied for transform');
        }
        
        $firstStage = null;
        $currentStage = null;
        
        foreach ($transforms as $transform) {
            $stage = new PipelineStage(function(ImageResource $res) use ($transform) {
                if (!$res->isValid()) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid resource in pipeline');
                }
                $this->applyTransform($res, $transform);
                return $res;
            });
            
            if ($firstStage === null) {
                $firstStage = $stage;
                $currentStage = $stage;
            } else {
                $currentStage = $currentStage->chain($stage);
            }
        }
        
        $firstStage->setResource($resource);
        
        // Register completion callback that captures resource reference
        $this->registerAsyncCallback('pipeline_complete', function() use ($resource) {
            // This callback retains a reference to $resource
            $this->onPipelineComplete($resource);
        }, $resource);
        
        $result = $firstStage->execute();
        
        // Release resource after pipeline execution
        $resource->release();
        
        return $result;
    }
    
    public function triggerEvent(string $eventName) {
        if (!isset($this->asyncCallbacks[$eventName])) {
            return;
        }
        foreach ($this->asyncCallbacks[$eventName] as $entry) {
            // Check resource validity before executing callback
            if (!$entry['resource']->isValid()) {
                continue;
            }
            ($entry['fn'])();
        }
        // Release callback references
        foreach ($this->asyncCallbacks[$eventName] as $entry) {
            $entry['resource']->release();
        }
        unset($this->asyncCallbacks[$eventName]);
    }
    
    private function onPipelineComplete(ImageResource $resource) {
        // Safe: resource validity is checked before this is called
        $handle = $resource->getHandle();
        if ($handle) {
            $width = imagesx($handle);
            $height = imagesy($handle);
            error_log("Pipeline complete: {$width}x{$height}");
        }
    }
    
    private function applyTransform(ImageResource $resource, array $transform) {
        $handle = $resource->getHandle();
        switch ($transform['type'] ?? '') {
            case 'resize':
                $newWidth = (int)($transform['width'] ?? imagesx($handle));
                $newHeight = (int)($transform['height'] ?? imagesy($handle));
                $newHandle = imagecreatetruecolor($newWidth, $newHeight);
                imagecopyresampled($newHandle, $handle, 0, 0, 0, 0, $newWidth, $newHeight, imagesx($handle), imagesy($handle));
                break;
            case 'rotate':
                $angle = (float)($transform['angle'] ?? 0);
                imagerotate($handle, $angle, 0);
                break;
        }
    }
    
    public function cleanup() {
        // Release any remaining async callback references
        foreach ($this->asyncCallbacks as $eventName => $callbacks) {
            foreach ($callbacks as $entry) {
                $entry['resource']->release();
            }
        }
        $this->asyncCallbacks = [];
        foreach ($this->resourcePool as $resource) {
            $resource->release();
        }
        $this->resourcePool = [];
    }
}

// Usage example
$rbac = new RoleBasedAccessControl();
$pipeline = new ImageProcessingPipeline($rbac);

try {
    $image = $pipeline->loadImage('/var/uploads/photo.jpg', 'editor');
    $pipeline->processWithTransform($image, 'editor', [
        ['type' => 'resize', 'width' => 800, 'height' => 600],
        ['type' => 'rotate', 'angle' => 90]
    ]);
    
    // Later, async event fires - resource is still valid due to addRef
    $pipeline->triggerEvent('pipeline_complete');
} finally {
    $pipeline->cleanup();
}
